text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—Still, watching you guys train
always feels so refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, just like... striking flint with a hard crack!
And seeing the spark catch in one shot, ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: I know! For the next staff meal, how about I make your favorites!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's do that! Man, I'm itching for action!
DAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tucker Brine praised me
again, and again, and again!
